source: These fell looking gloves glow with untold power.

source:
This mural shows nine Sher'Tul standing side by side, each holding aloft a dark weapon. Your eyes are drawn to a runed staff held by the red-robed figure in the centre. It seems familiar somehow...
There is some text beneath

下面有一行文字

source: A terrifying vampiric figure of power, with flowing robes and an intense aura of fright.  His cold, sinewy flesh seems to cling to this world through greed and malice, and his eyes betray a strength of mind beyond any puny mortal.  All nearby are utterly subservient to his will, though he stands aloof from them, as if to say he needs not the pathetic meddling of minions to help him overcome his foes.  Your eyes are drawn to a dark staff in his hands which seems to suck the very life from the air around it.  It looks ancient and dangerous and terrible, and the sight of it fills you with fervent desire.
target: 一个拥有强大力量的可怕吸血鬼，他的长袍无风自动，周身环绕着恐惧光环。他冰冷而精瘦的肉体似乎全凭贪婪与恶意才得以留驻人间，他的眼神透露出远超凡俗之辈的强大意志。周围所有生物都完全服从于他的意志，尽管如此，他仍对他们保持超然疏离，就好像他不需要这些废物来御敌一样。你的目光被他手里的黑色法杖所吸引，这根法杖似乎在不断的吸取周围的活力。它看起来古老、危险而可怕，看到它的瞬间，你心底的欲望被彻底点燃了。

source:
Sear your hatred into the mind of a target, dealing escalating Mind damage each turn over %d turns. The victim will suffer %0.1f damage on the first turn, slowly increasing up to %0.1f damage on the last, dealing %d Mind damage in total. Re-applying the effect resets the damage escalation. The victim has a 25%% chance of suffering Brainlock each turn from the unbearable pain.

The damage increases with your Mindpower.
target:
将你的憎恨灼入目标的心智，在 %d 回合内每回合造成不断升级的精神伤害。第一回合会造成 %0.1f 点精神伤害并在最后 1 回合增加至 %0.1f 点，总计 %d 点精神伤害。重复施加这一效果会把伤害值重置为初始伤害值。
被影响的敌人每回合有 25%% 概率附加思维封锁效果。

伤害受精神强度加成。

source: This sceptre, carved of ancient, blackened bone, holds a single gem of deep obsidian. You feel a dark power from deep within, looking to get out.

source: The gem's matter gradually transforms, granting %0.2f psi per turn.
target: 宝石缓慢转化，每回合产生 %0.2f 灵能值。

deep_observation: 机制信息漏译。源串 "Doing so requires no turn but you are considered disarmed for 2 turns" 的核心机制是「不消耗回合」，译文「立刻装填 %d 弹药。之后缴械 2 回合。」只用「立刻」含混带过，完全没有「不消耗回合／不占用行动」的表述，读者无法判断该技能是否要花一回合；补查 mod-tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/talents/misc/npcs.lua（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，newTalent Reload，第 2699-2730 行）确认该 talent 字段为 no_energy = true，即确实不消耗回合，属可核验的机制项。同一句另有两处漏译／偏移：(1) "(depends on masteries and object bonuses)" 整个括注被删，装填量随专精与装备加成变化这一信息丢失，源码 info 用 :tformat(self:reloadRate()) 填入 %d 印证该值为派生值；(2) "but you are considered disarmed" 的 but 转折与 considered（视为缴械，源码为 setEffect(self.EFF_RELOAD_DISARMED, 1, {})）被改写成「之后缴械」，把与装填同时生效的代价说成装填之后的后续阶段。建议改为「立刻装填 %d 弹药（取决于专精与装备加成）。此举不消耗回合，但你在 2 回合内被视为缴械。」
source:
Quickly reload your ammo by %d (depends on masteries and object bonuses).
		Doing so requires no turn but you are considered disarmed for 2 turns.

		Reloading does not break stealth.
surface_observation: 原文明确说明装填量取决于精通和物品加成（depends on masteries and object bonuses），且装填不消耗回合（requires no turn）；译文遗漏这两项信息，“立刻”未明确表达不消耗回合。
target:

		装填弹药不会打破潜行。

deep_observation: 相邻判定的锚点译错，且删除了限定词。源串 "hit up to two adjacent enemies" 是九头蛇之咬（Hydra's Bite）的 special_on_hit 描述；补查 mod-tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua（commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 3681 行起 special_on_hit.fct）确认候选目标由 util.adjacentCoords(who.x, who.y) 枚举，即以持有者自身（who）为中心取相邻格，并以 targ ~= target 排除原目标；同物品 desc 亦为 "hitting everyone around you"。译文「攻击目标相邻的2个单位」把锚点错标为「目标」相邻，与源码和 desc 均相反，玩家会据此误判站位。其次 "up to" 被删：源码中 tgts 只有 1 个候选（#tgts==1）或去重重试 100 次失败（tries >= 100）时会置 twohits=nil，只打 1 个，因此固定说「2 个」把上限说成必然值。另 enemies 泛化为「单位」也弱化了敌我限定（源码以 reactionToward < 0 过滤）。建议改为「攻击你身边最多 2 个相邻敌人」。
source: hit up to two adjacent enemies
surface_observation: 原文 up to two adjacent enemies 表示至多两个相邻敌人，译文“攻击目标相邻的2个单位”遗漏“至多”和敌人限定，并增加原文未明确的“目标”作为相邻参照。
target: 攻击目标相邻的2个单位
